title: Puppy chow
hookLine: Viral American puppy chow crafted for mobile Cook Mode & 1-tap Story sharing.

items.name: Softened butter or creamy nut butter

steps.title: Line Pan & Prep Base Ingredients
steps.instructionTemplate: Line a loaf pan, baking dish, or serving glasses with parchment paper or chill them in the fridge for 5 minutes. Measure out {eu23_but} and {eu23_sug} so your base whips up thick, creamy, and clump-free.

steps.title: Transfer, Smooth Top & Add Garnish
steps.instructionTemplate: Pour or press the mixture evenly into your prepared dish, smoothing the surface with a spatula. Scatter {eu23_flr} and {eu23_flv} evenly across the top and press gently so it adheres cleanly.

steps.title: Toss in Melted Coating & Chill
steps.instructionTemplate: Melt {eu23_but} with {eu23_flv}, fold over {eu23_flr}, coat generously with {eu23_sug}, and chill 15 mins to set crisp. Gently press the coating onto every side so it adheres evenly, then let excess drip off before transferring to a clean tray.
steps.creatorSecret: Let the tray rest 5 minutes on the counter after baking so edges crisp while centers stay bakery-soft.

steps.title: Chill Until Firm, Slice & Store
steps.instructionTemplate: Cover and refrigerate Puppy chow until completely firm and sliceable. Portion into 12 servings, add any crisp toppings right before serving, and keep leftovers chilled in an airtight container for up to 5 days.

ugcQuotes.quote: Zero-fluff steps + Cook Mode timer nailed it on the first batch!
